paid_output.final_cta: Сохрани, если хочешь быстро вернуться к главным сдвигам недели.
paid_output.final_caption: В этой неделе нет одной большой темы — и в этом как раз её смысл. OpenAI говорит о меньшем числе ошибок, Apollo собирают для древнегреческого, Xiaomi открывает веса MiMo-V2.6, а AGENTS.md становится понятнее для инструментов, которые работают с ИИ-агентами. Технологии одновременно становятся точнее, доступнее и немного страннее.

creative_execution_plan.main_idea: One editorial week shown as a sequence of concrete objects and scenes: fewer errors, expanding digital identity, ancient language, premium hardware, open models and shared agent instructions.
creative_execution_plan.focal_point: Every slide isolates one surprising factual relationship and gives it a recognisable visual metaphor or real image.
creative_execution_plan.media_rationale: Most supplied images are text-heavy article cards and unsuitable for final visuals; generated contextual scenes provide story-specific imagery, while the suitable Apollo image anchors the sequence with real media.
creative_execution_plan.composition_direction: Move from a dark, high-impact comparison into alternating light and dark story scenes, then finish with a calm visual constellation that gathers the recurring motifs.
creative_execution_plan.branding_treatment: Use restrained red editorial accents, large condensed headlines, clear safe margins and consistent corner branding without product claims.
creative_execution_plan.visual_treatment: Cohesive editorial still lifes and metaphors on paper, graphite and ink surfaces; blank objects and screens keep all factual language in the renderer’s typography.
creative_execution_plan.avoid_recent_treatment: No recent Instagram treatment is available; avoid defaulting to flat article-card screenshots despite their presence in the source media.

visual_rhythm.arc: The carousel opens with a sharp model comparison, moves through increasingly unusual and practical stories, then closes by connecting their different directions into one memorable weekly pattern.
visual_rhythm.repetition_note: Generated object scenes repeat the same restrained editorial still-life language, but each uses a different story-specific relationship and composition.

reference.editorial_angle: The week's jaw-dropper: OpenAI says Luna matches GPT-5.6 Sol at about 1% of its cost (E4) - open with that, then give every story its practical 'so what' (fewer errors, IDs on the phone, a free Ancient Greek model, open weights, one agent-instruction standard across rivals).
reference.final_caption: Неделя в ИИ и технологиях: OpenAI показала GPT-6 Sol и Luna, Apple Wallet добирается почти до 20 штатов, Apollo учит древнегреческий, vivo продаёт титановые часы от $149, Xiaomi открыла веса MiMo-V2.6, а Claude Code перешёл на формат инструкций OpenAI.

Apollo обучили примерно на 600 млн исторических греческих слов. Делают Австрийская академия наук, Mistral и Sail Reply — модель обещают бесплатной.
Это новые vivo Watch 6. Внутри ещё датчики пульса и кислорода в крови.
